summary: The agent implements a solid time-series forecasting solution with good practices like a 16-day lag shift to avoid lookahead bias, clean target encoding, and a strict temporal validation split. However, it fails to retrain the models on the full dataset (including the validation set) before predicting on the test set, which loses valuable recent data. Additionally, it reports validation scores on the same set used for early stopping, uses hardcoded ensemble weights without tuning, and evaluates stochastic models only once.
